content: The TCT 2011 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events during the conference. Filming will occur in front of the Main Arena in the Moscone South building. Open time slots are marked in red. Below are the scheduled interviews and topics: Tuesday, November 8, 2011 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Dr. Ron Waksman will discuss the DESERT study, a large-scale, multicenter, case-controlled study examining predictors of stent thrombosis. The embargo lifts at 11:50 AM on Wednesday, November 9, 2011. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Dr. Justin Davies will present ADVISE, a validation of a vasodilator-independent measure of coronary fractional flow reserve. The embargo lifts at 12:25 PM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Dr. David Cohen will discuss PARTNER Cohort A QOL, focusing on quality of life outcomes. The embargo lifts at 11:33 AM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Dr. Dominick Angiolillo will present BRIDGE, a prospective, double-blind, multicenter, randomized placebo-controlled trial of intravenous cangrelor in patients awaiting surgery. The embargo lifts at 12:45 PM on Wednesday, November 9, 2011. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Dr. Gennaro Sardella will compare high reloading doses of rosuvastatin and atorvastatin pretreatment in patients undergoing elective PCI to reduce myocardial periprocedural necrosis (ROMA II Reload). The embargo lifts at 7:30 PM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Dr. Anna Sonia Petronio will discuss MUSTELA, a prospective, randomized trial of thrombectomy versus no thrombectomy in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction and thrombus-rich lesions. The embargo lifts at 12:35 PM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Dr. Harald Rittger will present PEPCAD-DES, a prospective, randomized trial of paclitaxel-coated balloon angioplasty versus uncoated balloon angioplasty in patients with restenosis of drug-eluting stents. The embargo lifts at 11:40 AM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Dr. Clemens von Birgelen will discuss TWENTE, a prospective, randomized trial comparing zotarolimus-eluting stents and everolimus-eluting stents in patients with coronary artery disease. The embargo lifts at 12:05 PM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Dr. Leif Thuesen will present STACCATO, a prospective, randomized trial of transapical transcatheter aortic valve replacement versus surgical aortic valve replacement in low-surgical-risk elderly patients with aortic stenosis. The embargo lifts at 11:51 AM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Dr. Tullio Palmerini and Dr. Mark Connolly will engage in a debate on everolimus-eluting stents (EES). 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Dr. Ajay Kirtane will provide a TCT wrap-up. Wednesday, November 9, 2011 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Dr. Enrico Romagnoli will discuss RIFLE STEACS, a prospective, randomized trial of radial versus femoral vascular access in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo lifts at 12:25 PM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Dr. Matthew Reynolds will present PARTNER Cohort A CE, a cost-effectiveness analysis from a prospective, randomized trial of transcatheter aortic valve replacement versus surgical aortic valve replacement in high-surgical-risk patients with aortic stenosis. The embargo lifts at 12:45 PM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Dr. Roxana Mehran will discuss PARIS, a large-scale, prospective, multicenter registry study examining patterns and reasons for non-adherence to antiplatelet agents in stented patients. The embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on Wednesday, November 9, 2011. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Dr. Pieter R. Stella will present DEB-AMI, a prospective, randomized trial of paclitaxel-coated balloons plus bare-metal stents versus paclitaxel-eluting stents versus bare-metal stents alone in patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The embargo lifts at 12:45 PM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Dr. Dietmar Trenk will discuss TRIGGER-PCI, a prospective, randomized trial of prasugrel versus clopidogrel in clopidogrel-hyporesponsive patients with stable ischemic heart disease undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention. The embargo lifts at 12:35 PM on Wednesday, November 9, 2011. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Dr. Ajay Kirtane will provide a TCT wrap-up. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Dr. Sigmund Silber will provide a TCT wrap-up in German. 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Dr. Stefan James will provide a TCT wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. Thursday, November 10, 2011 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Dr. Juan Gaspar will provide a TCT wrap-up in Spanish. 11:30 AM 12:00 PM: Dr. Didier Carrié will present NEXT, a prospective, randomized trial comparing the Cre8 polymer-free stent eluting sirolimus to a paclitaxel-eluting stent. The embargo lifts at 11:30 AM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Dr. Subhash Banerjee will discuss COBRA, a prospective, randomized trial of cryoplasty versus conventional balloon post-dilation of nitinol stents in the superficial femoral artery of patients with diabetes mellitus. The embargo lifts at 1:00 PM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Prof. Ian Meredith will present EVOLVE, a prospective, randomized trial of two dose formulations of a bioabsorbable polymer-based everolimus-eluting stent versus a durable polymer-based everolimus-eluting stent. The embargo lifts at 11:10 AM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Dr. Derek So will discuss Rapid GENE, a prospective, randomized trial of prasugrel versus clopidogrel in CYP2C192 carriers identified by rapid point-of-care genotyping. The embargo lifts at 1:00 PM on Wednesday, November 9, 2011. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Dr. Raj Makkar will present PARTNER Cohort B 2-Year, a prospective, randomized trial of transcatheter aortic valve replacement versus standard therapy in patients with inoperable aortic stenosis. The embargo lifts at 11:25 AM on Thursday, November 10, 2011. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Dr. Gert Richardt will discuss ROTAXUS, a prospective, randomized trial of high-speed rotational atherectomy prior to paclitaxel-eluting stent implantation in complex calcified coronary artery lesions. The embargo lifts at 12:15 PM on Friday, November 11, 2011. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Dr. Ajay Kirtane will provide a TCT wrap-up. This schedule provides a detailed breakdown of the interviews, topics, and embargo times for the TCT 2011 conference.
